text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"We have five Muses this year! 
The first-ever Triple Tiara winner, the 
legendary queen, Mejiro Ramonu!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"And the New Beauties who will illuminate 
the future of the Tiara path! 
Cesario, Rhein Kraft, Air Messiah, and 
Daring Heart!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Having completed their fateful 
engagement, they will pledge their 'Love 
for Racing' in today's ceremony of vows!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—My vow is one of benevolence toward 
racing. As part of this unending history, 
I will pass on the achievements spun by my 
predecessors to the beloved children of 
the future."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I will become that cornerstone. 
With a deep, immense, and heartfelt love. 
...I so swear."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"—My vow is the thrilling heartbeat for 
the Tiara. Within the history of the Tiara 
that I love so much, I want to etch my own 
radiant shine."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"To leave behind proof that brings that 
very excitement to someone else. 
So that this thrill connects on and on, 
forever and ever."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"—My vow is respect for my mother. Those 
beautiful days when she dedicated 
everything to racing—this time, it's my 
turn to shine that light."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I will prove it. My strength. My mother's 
strength. 
With this unwavering respect and love."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—My vow is to the throne of the Queen. 
Clashing with my rivals, putting my pride 
on the line to claim the summit."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I will etch my absolute best into the 
turf. 
With this blazing heart of mine."

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: —We so swear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Now, let the race begin.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"And they're off in the Beauty Dream Cup! 
Mejiro Ramonu takes the early lead, 
seizing control of the race!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Rounding the third corner—Rhein Kraft is 
the first to make a move! 
Daring Heart is also closing in, looking 
to catch Mejiro Ramonu's shadow!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Behind them, Air Messiah and Cesario are 
watching like hawks for their chance! 
Coming off the fourth corner and into the 
homestretch!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ramonu shows no signs of slowing 
down! 
Chasing right behind, the four are lined 
up abreast! Is Mejiro Ramonu still too far 
ahead?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Not yet. Not just yet...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I will catch you! 
This time, without fail—!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I am the one who loves racing the most! 
I am the one yearning for that finish line 
the most! That's why—!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I'll seize it! I will claim this love—!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You've truly polished yourselves well. 
Shining brighter than ever before. That is 
precisely why—"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Ramonu! It's Mejiro Ramonu!! 
Unstoppable as ever, Mejiro Ramonu puts on 
an overwhelmingly dominant performance!"

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"Following right behind in a line! For a 
moment, they almost caught Mejiro Ramonu's 
shadow—magnificent closing speed from all 
four of them!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*... She's as strong as 
ever... 
However—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was able to close the distance more than 
ever before. 
Next time... Someday, I will definitely 
reach that back of hers...!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Magnificent, all five of you! That was 
the absolute peak of beauty!! 
Now then, one last time, the bouquets for 
you all!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was the most wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "—Excuse me, everyone?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "! Ah, yes! Thank y—!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"A flawless race... A flawless ceremony. 
—This is what I desired. For the sake of 
my love."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You polished yourselves up exquisitely. 
*Chuckle*... For a moment I thought you 
might disappoint, but... you really are 
strong, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... Thank you very much. 
To have you say that to us, Ramonu-san..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... yes, your dream. To be a 
cornerstone for the future—was it? 
How noble. Not bad at all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I have high hopes for your dreams... and 
the fruits of your 'love.' 
To see how that young love blooms, 
ripens—and what kind of fruit it bears."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... How delightful. When that day 
comes, I— 
would love to savor that 'fruit' myself. 
Out on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Please look forward to it. 
Both our results, and the future we 
connect."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—I want you to look forward to it... and 
fear it, too. 
Because I will, without a doubt—surpass 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"—Very well. 
I shall embrace it, my pale pink... Petite 
fleur."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"However... would you leave the two of us 
alone for now? 
I wish to savor the afterglow. It was a 
perfect, beautiful—and magnificent 
ceremony, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Ah—my beloved, darling you. 
I have yearned for you ceaselessly. 
Harboring this madly burning love within 
me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Tell me, won't you? I want to make love 
to you just as you are. 
We don't need any superfluous decorations 
between the two of us, do we—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "—! The flowers...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, hahahaha...! 
Ah, yes—this turf, always and forever, 
sets my heart ablaze...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing—and no one—can stand in our way. 
No one can surpass us!"
[System Monologue]

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —For my love is the ultimate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I will come to see you again... 
My beloved, precious you."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"—Love. 
The love that Umamusume pour into their 
racing."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It is love that drives us, love that 
empowers us. 
And that is—"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you seek it, no matter 
how hard you pursue it—there is no end.
